name: Parada
description: Parada was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Hadar sector. It was home to the giant herbivorous herd creatures known as wombacks. Parada exported womback hides and meat, as well as a variety of grains, offworld, and it provided most of the food for the Ado sector planet Ord Gimmel.
lead_paragraphs: Parada was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Hadar sector. It was home to the giant herbivorous herd creatures known as wombacks. Parada exported womback hides and meat, as well as a variety of grains, offworld, and it provided most of the food for the Ado sector planet Ord Gimmel.
